name: Mori AeroX frameset

editorial.verdict: A documented aero-gravel option with good support, but its 45C limit and 430 mm chainstays make it a near-miss for a road-like, very-wide-clearance build.
caveats: Clearance is lower than several cheaper modern frames
Extended gravel geometry rather than literal road geometry

purchase_route: Official Elves online shops sell the exact Mori AeroX frameset directly; confirm the mainland-China storefront, paint, seatpost offset, included T47 bottom bracket option and warranty route before ordering.
